contentSections.heading: The 11:47 PM Problem
contentSections.text: It's 11:47 PM. You're finally comfortable — tucked in, phone down, eyes heavy. Then it hits you: 'Did I leave the living room lights on?' With the Smart WiFi Switch, you never have to drag yourself out of bed again. Control everything from your smartphone.

contentSections.heading: Military-Grade Reliability
contentSections.text: Designed to withstand Nigerian power fluctuations, our switches use Magnetic Latching Relays that cost 3x more but provide 10x the reliability. They don't just work—they last. Experience zero static power consumption and ultra-low heat generation.

faqs.question: Do I need a neutral wire?
faqs.answer: No. These switches support both Neutral and No-Neutral wiring methods. No capacitor is required for the No-Neutral setup.

faqs.question: What happens if WiFi goes down?
faqs.answer: The physical glass buttons still work as regular manual switches. Smart features only require WiFi for remote and voice control.
